top5_telemetry_selector.candidate_set: frozen cumulative-NLL ranks 1..5 at each true Gold-opportunity frontier state
top5_telemetry_selector.train_states: states where Gold is inside NLL Top5; states with Gold outside Top5 remain in overall evaluation as unreachable by a Top5-only selector
models: Pairwise Logistic: Gold-vs-every-nonGold-in-Top5 symmetric feature differences, same estimator
metrics: conditional Top1/MRR given Gold in Top5

passive_primary.representation: parent-prefix hidden state because an unexpanded retained child has no child-prefix hidden state without an extra forward
passive_primary.model_identity: Qwen3-4B, 36 transformer layers; no layer selection after results
passive_primary.capture: for every expanded parent keep selected-layer last-token states only while it has pending retained children; when any child first enters current NLL Top5, persist the parent states keyed by parent/work-item lineage; deduplicate
passive_primary.selector_features: concatenated parent hidden states plus frozen Top5 telemetry candidate features; selected token identity remains forbidden
passive_primary.probe: training-only PCA to 64 components per layer followed by L2 logistic regression; secondary per-layer probes are diagnostics only

active_child_secondary.status: NOT AUTHORIZED BEFORE PASSIVE PROBE RESULT
active_child_secondary.reason: requires extra prefix forward for nodes that have never been expanded

requirements: scientific candidate/checkpoint parity with P3 telemetry baseline

cpu_counterfactual.purpose: measure observational coverage and blind descendant-feature separability; never claim causal rollout performance
report_required: fraction of frontier states where all NLL Top5 candidates have >=q observed expanded descendants

gpu_policy_gate.execution: lookahead expansions count against the same scientific node budget; no hidden extra forward budget
runtime_requirements: useful forwards counted in R budget
gpu_policy_gate.progression: Micro12 only if q=8 smoke has sane runtime and at least one completed candidate; q=16 is not run unless q=8 is runtime-safe
